content.introduction: The sources provide details on economic calendars from TradingView, Trading Economics, and IG International. TradingView's Economic Calendar shows upcoming economic events affecting assets, regions, and global markets, with customizable options and expert forecasts. Trading Economics' calendar provides comprehensive data for 196 countries, including 300,000 economic indicators, actual values, consensus figures, and forecasts. IG International's calendar allows users to browse or search for macroeconomic events, earnings announcements, IPOs, and stock splits. Specific events listed include Industrial Production YoY AUG, 12-Month BOT Auction, ECB Cipollone Speech, Foreign Exchange Reserves OCT/02, and Inflation Rate MoM SEP.

# Calendar

## How to use Economic Calendar

Economic Calendar on TradingView shows the latest and upcoming economic events that can affect certain assets, regions, and global markets — for example, stocks, Forex, or bonds. [...] All events are in chronological order and linked with economic indicators like interest rates or GDP. The calendar is customizable: one click will give you a weekly economic calendar, another — narrow it down to US economic calendar only. Plus, you will see short explainers of the events and forecasts from experts. Just set your calendar and prepare for the next trade.

Learn more about the Economic Calendar features in our Help Center.
